verdict.rationale: Clerky is a SaaS that stores sensitive legal and formation data, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack does not document any retention settings, deletion controls, or data export or purge capability. The change log in clerky-docs-4 is an audit feature, not retention or deletion control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
